definition_zh: 取消；撤销；注销；（印刷）删除线
definition_en: the act of calling off or annulling something planned or agreed; also the marking of a stamp or ticket as used
core_image: 一枚盖章作废的机票：明明印好了行程，一条红线就把它划成了废纸
scene: 台风登陆前夜，机场大厅的航班信息牌上一片红字。Passengers were told of the cancellation by text message at midnight.
sceneCN: 这里 cancellation 是「航班取消」（第 1 个义项：使既定安排作废的行为或事实）；句意是乘客们在午夜收到短信，得知航班已取消。

derivatives.zh: 基础动词，义为「取消；撤销；盖销」
动词过去分词形容词化，义为「被取消的」（美式单写 l）
同上，英式双写 l 拼法
动词加施动后缀，义为「取消者；盖销装置」

senses.title: Calling off a planned event or arrangement
senses.definition: the act or fact of deciding that a planned event, service, or trip will not happen
senses.definitionCN: 决定使原定的活动、服务或行程不再发生的行为或事实
senses.example: The cancellation of the summit disappointed reporters.
senses.exampleCN: 峰会的取消让记者们大失所望。
senses.why: The Latin cancello meant to make lattice-like crosses, the marks that void a document.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 cancello 本义是打出交叉格纹，正是使文件作废的划线记号。

senses.title: Ending a contract or agreement
senses.definition: the legal termination of a contract, subscription, or standing agreement
senses.definitionCN: 对合同、订阅或长期协议的法律意义上的终止
senses.example: The cancellation clause allows either party to exit within thirty days.
senses.exampleCN: 合同中的解除条款允许任一方在三十天内退出。
senses.why: What was once crossed out by hand became, in law, a formal act of ending obligations.
senses.whyCN: 昔日手写划掉的动作，在法律中演变为正式解除义务的行为。

senses.title: Stamping or marking as used
senses.definition: the mark or process showing that a stamp or ticket has been used and cannot be used again
senses.definitionCN: 表明邮票或票据已使用、不得再次使用的记号或过程
senses.example: A crisp cancellation marked the hundred-year-old stamp.
senses.exampleCN: 一枚清晰的盖销戳标记着这枚百年邮票。
senses.why: This is the lattice mark in its original office: ink stamped across the stamp to void it.
senses.whyCN: 这正是交叉记号的原初岗位：以墨戳横盖邮票使其作废。

senses.title: Offsetting equal values
senses.definition: the elimination of equal but opposite amounts, as in accounting or algebra
senses.definitionCN: 数学或会计中相等而方向相反的量相互抵销、约去
senses.example: The cancellation of gains and losses left the ledger nearly flat.
senses.exampleCN: 盈亏相抵后，账目几乎持平。
senses.why: Two opposite strokes crossing each other leave nothing standing, so equal sums erase each other.
senses.whyCN: 两笔相交叉的笔画彼此抹去，等量的数目也就相互抵销。

intro.en: Cancellation descends from Latin cancelli, lattice bars or cross-hatching, the marks made to void a written line.
intro.cn: cancellation 源自拉丁语 cancelli（格栏、交叉线），即在文字上划出使其作废的记号。

items.en: The root *kan- relates to bending, the shape of woven lattice work.
items.cn: 词根 *kan- 与弯曲有关，正是编织格栏的形状。

items.en: Latin cancelli meant lattice, grating, or bars; the diminutive cancellus meant a small crossed line.
items.cn: 拉丁语 cancelli 指格栏、栅格；指小词 cancellus 意为一道小的交叉线。

items.en: In Roman scribal practice, to cancello a text was to cross it out with lattice strokes.
items.cn: 在罗马抄写实践中，对文本 cancello 即用交叉线将其划掉。

items.en: The verb cancel entered Middle English with the crossing-out sense, and cancellation followed for the act or the mark.
items.cn: 动词 cancel 于中古英语时期带着「划掉」义进入英语，cancellation 随之表示该行为或记号。

items.en: Modern usage centers on voided plans and agreements, with the stamp and accounting senses preserved in specialist contexts.
items.cn: 现代用法集中于被取消的计划与协议，盖销义和会计义保留在专门语境中。

note.en: Cancellation sits inside the cancel family and next to other -cel- words that confuse spelling.
note.cn: cancellation 属 cancel 词族内部，且与几个 -cel- 拼写相近的词容易混淆。

entries.definition: The base verb, to call off or cross out.
An office of a chancellor, from the lattice screens around such offices.
entries.definitionCN: 总理府、大臣官署，源自官署周围隔出格栏。

entries.definition: Spongy, lattice-like bone tissue, named for its grid structure.
entries.definitionCN: 海绵状、网格样的骨组织，因格状结构得名，同根专业词。

entries.definition: An assembly that advises; sounds partly alike but from a different root.
entries.definitionCN: 议事会，发音部分相似，词根不同。

entries.definition: A formal declaration that a marriage or contract never validly existed.
entries.definitionCN: 宣告婚姻或合同自始无效的法律程序。

entries.definition: The unwinding of a contract, restoring both parties to prior positions.
entries.definitionCN: 合同的解除回转，使双方回到订约前的状态。

entries.definition: A delay rather than an ending; the event still happens later.
entries.definitionCN: 延期而非终止，活动稍后仍会举行。

entries.definition: The formal ending of a system, law, or practice.
entries.definitionCN: 对制度、法律或惯例的正式废除。

entries.definition: The restoration of something canceled to its former standing.
entries.definitionCN: 使被取消者恢复原状，是 cancellation 的反义对照。

normalIntro.en: Five hooks on the lattice root and the everyday cancel family.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕「格栏」词根与日常 cancel 词族的记忆钩子。

normal.en: Root picture: Latin cancelli are lattice bars, and the cross-stroke voids a line of writing.
normal.cn: 词根画面：拉丁语 cancelli 是格栏，交叉一笔就把一行字作废。

normal.en: Spelling rule: British cancellation doubles the l after the stressed -el-; American cancels with one l.
normal.cn: 拼写规则：英式 cancellation 双写 l；美式在 canceled 中单写 l。

normal.en: Family words: cancel, cancellation, and canceler all live on the same Latin stem.
normal.cn: 词族成员：cancel、cancellation、canceler 都长在同一拉丁词干上。

normal.en: Money angle: a cancellation fee is the standard phrase for the penalty charged after backing out.
normal.cn: 金钱角度：cancellation fee 是违约取消费的标准说法。

normal.en: Same-root cousin: chancellery, a chancellor's office, keeps the lattice screen in its history.
normal.cn: 同根表亲：chancellery（总理府）在历史里保留着格栏屏风的身影。

abstract.en: A red diagonal slashed across a printed itinerary: the trip now lives only in memory.
abstract.cn: 一道红色斜线划过打印好的行程单：旅程从此只存在于记忆里。

abstract.en: Two equal opposing arrows colliding and vanishing into nothing.
abstract.cn: 两支大小相等方向相反的箭相撞后凭空消失。

abstract.en: An ink stamp blooming across a postage stamp, declaring it spent.
abstract.cn: 一方墨戳在邮票上绽开，宣告它已被使用。

examples.en: The airline offered vouchers as compensation for the cancellation.
examples.cn: 航空公司提供了代金券作为航班取消的补偿。

examples.en: Repeated cancellations of the committee meetings stalled the reform.
examples.cn: 委员会会议一再取消，改革因此停滞。

examples.en: The accountant checked the ledger for the cancellation of the duplicate entries.
examples.cn: 会计核对了账簿中重复条目的冲销情况。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「堪守雷申」——航班一取消，只能堪堪守在机场，雷霆大雨里申诉赔偿；联想机票被红笔划出一道道格子线，行程作废，即为取消。

root: 源自拉丁语 cancelli（格栏、栅格），指小形式 cancellus 意为小交叉线；罗马书吏以交叉线划掉文字，故 cancellare 意为「划掉、使作废」。动词经中古英语 cancel 进入英语，cancellation 由其加 -ation 构成，指取消的行为、事实或盖销记号。同根词 chancellery（官署）亦出自格栏意象。

sensesIntro.en: From the crossed-out line the word covers voided plans, terminated contracts, stamped-out tickets, and offsetting sums.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「被划掉的一行字」出发，词义涵盖被取消的计划、被解除的合同、被盖销的票证以及相互抵销的数目。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: cross-hatched strokes drawn over writing to void it.
core.cn: 核心意象：在文字上画出的交叉格纹，使其一笔作废。

branches.en: THE BOARD: announced events that will no longer happen.
branches.cn: 公告牌：不再举行的活动安排。

branches.en: THE CLAUSE: legal endings written into agreements.
branches.cn: 条款：写进协议的法律终止机制。

branches.en: THE POST OFFICE: ink marks that spend a stamp forever.
branches.cn: 邮局：让邮票永久作废的墨戳。

branches.en: THE LEDGER: equal opposites canceling to zero.
branches.cn: 账簿：等量反向、相抵归零。

branches.en: THE PAPER TRAIL: notices, fees, and clauses that follow every canceled plan.
branches.cn: 文书轨迹：每次取消计划后随之而来的通知、费用与条款。

intro.en: Cancellation is the Latin stem cancell- plus the noun suffix -ation, the act or result of canceling.
intro.cn: cancellation 由拉丁词干 cancell- 加名词后缀 -ation 构成，指取消的行为或结果。

latinIntro.en: The cancell- root names lattice work and crossed lines, feeding both legal and everyday English.
latinIntro.cn: cancell- 词根既指格栏也指交叉线，同时滋养了法律与日常英语。

items.exampleCN: 神庙的栅栏（拉丁语用例示意）。
把文字划掉（拉丁语用例示意）。

items.meaningCN: 表示行为或结果的名词后缀

items.meaning: one who or that which cancels
items.example: an automatic canceler on the press
items.exampleCN: 印刷机上的自动盖销装置。

latinEntries.exampleCN: 祭坛前的栏杆（拉丁语用例示意）。
